Container.Name: EncodeHarbor
Container.Overview: Automatically compress videos with FFmpeg. Watch folders, choose quality profiles and working hours, and track progress in a responsive web interface. Files are always delivered: compressed when smaller, otherwise unchanged. Input cleanup is optional and disabled by default.
Container.Requires: Use separate input, output, work and config folders. Change the cache path to your actual pool name. Output storage must support hard links. The web interface has no login; use a trusted network or your own access proxy.

Config.Name: Input videos
Config.Description: Source videos. Writable for optional cleanup; deletion is disabled by default.

Config.Name: Output videos
Config.Description: Smaller compressed videos or unchanged originals. Must support hard links; keep separate from input.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Persistent queue and settings. Use persistent local storage.

Config.Name: Working storage
Config.Description: Temporary videos. Change cache to your actual pool name. Must be dedicated to this instance.

Config.Name: Filesystem user ID
Config.Description: Non-root numeric user ID for the application and FFmpeg.

Container.ExtraSearchTerms: ffmpeg video compress transcode watch folder working hours
